description: You have been handed ownership of an inbox organization project that was started by a departing colleague but never finished. Two folders already exist: 'Security-Discussion' (with emails about spam filtering and security topics) and 'Hardware-Issues' (with emails about RAID, Solaris, and hardware problems). However, 40+ emails remain completely unsorted in your inbox. Your tasks: (1) Review the existing folder structure and the remaining inbox emails to understand what categories are represented. (2) Create at least 3 additional folders for the distinct categories you identify in the remaining emails. (3) Move ALL remaining inbox emails into your new folders — aim for inbox zero (no more than 5 emails remaining). (4) Compose an email to project-director@devteam.com with subject 'Inbox Organization Complete - Final Status' listing all 5 folders (the 2 existing plus your 3+ new ones), their email counts, and a one-sentence description of each folder's content type. Login: username ga, password password123.
